svg.title: Everland or Lotte World: A Three-Question Decision Tree / Everland or Lotte World Adventure
svg.desc: Three questions. Question one: Only half a day or an evening, or rain, snow or a cold snap? Yes: Lotte World, directly linked to Jamsil Station on Lines 2 and 8, Exit 4; Sunday–Thursday 10:00–21:00, Friday–Saturday 10:00–22:00; adult combo ticket 67,000 KRW. No: question two. Want T Express, the wooden coaster, pandas, wildlife and seasonal flowers? Yes: Everland. Suin–Bundang Line to Giheung, then Yongin Everline to Jeondae·Everland; transit card 1,550 KRW; first train 05:30, last 23:30. Tickets have date-based price tiers; check the official site. No: question three. With preschoolers and a stroller, and want less travel time? Yes: Lotte World. Short indoor routes, easy stroller access; evening entry through closing is good value. Magic Pass is limited: buy it first on entry. No: visit both over two days—Everland all day on the first, Lotte World from afternoon to closing on the second. Staying in Jamsil or Gangnam is most convenient. Two boxes below: Everland—arrive at opening, head to T Express first; Q-Pass is limited; outdoor rides close in rain. Lotte World—last entry 1 hour before closing; Atlantis and Gyro Drop have hour-long queues on holidays; Seoul Sky is in the same block.
svg.text: Everland or Lotte World: Decide in Three Questions (verified 2026/9)
Everland or Lotte World Adventure: a three-question decision tree
Question 1: Only half a day or an evening,
or rain, snow or a cold snap that day?
Yes
Lotte World
Jamsil Station: Lines 2 and 8, direct access via Exit 4
Sun–Thu 10:00 to 21:00 · Fri–Sat 10:00 to 22:00
Adult combo ₩67,000 (Korea Tourism Organization page)
No
Question 2: Want T Express, the wooden coaster,
pandas, wildlife and seasonal flowers?
Yes
Everland
Suin–Bundang → Giheung; Everline → Jeondae·Everland
Transit card ₩1,550 · First 05:30 · Last 23:30
Date-tiered prices; check the official site for your date
No
Question 3: Preschoolers and a stroller,
and want to cut travel time?
Yes
Lotte World with Young Children
Short indoor routes, easy stroller access
Evening entry until closing is good value
Magic Pass is limited: buy it first on entry
No
Visit Both over Two Days
Day one: a full day at Everland
Day two: Lotte World, afternoon to closing
Stay in Jamsil or Gangnam for easiest access
Everland: Plan Your Visit
Arrive at opening; T Express first. Paid Q-Pass is limited and sells out soon after opening
Animal zone (Lost Valley, Panda World) at midday; seasonal flowers and Halloween at dusk
Rain closes outdoor rides; last Everline train 23:30—plan your return if staying until closing
Lotte World: Plan Your Visit
Last entry 1 hour before closing; hour-long holiday queues are normal for Atlantis and Gyro Drop
Magic Pass Premium is limited; enjoy the indoor hall in rain and winter
Seoul Sky, Lotte Department Store and the supermarket share a block; combine dinner and shopping

Hours and prices verified 2026/9: Lotte World information follows the Korea Tourism Organization page. Everland uses date-tiered prices; check its official daily announcement. Yongin Everline fares and first/last trains follow its official site.
